P2_earnings_gate_recovered.reading: joint passes at least as many earnings seeds as da and more than stanreg alone

rule.C1: geometric mean over the 17 models of the seed-median min-bulk-ESS/gradient ratio owalnuts-joint / owalnuts-da >= 1.15 (a model with a missing median on either side is excluded from the geomean and reported)
rule.C2: no model has that ratio below 0.85
rule.C3: cells passing all gates: joint >= da (out of 51)
rule.C4: funnel tail-mass |z| <= 2 on every seed for joint under both the paper tuning and the sampler defaults (MCSE statistic; the other arms are reported as controls)
rule.C5: Eight Schools strict-track geomean min-bulk-ESS/call ratio joint / da >= 0.9
rule.not_gated: the rhosum and stanreg arms (reported); wall and ESS/s (shared machine, upper bounds); the v3 reproduction of da; the predictions below
rule.statement: Flip the sampler defaults to UTurnRule::MomentumSum + DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan together if and only if all five hold for the joint arm; otherwise leave the defaults and report why. The rhosum and stanreg arms are reported (they attribute the joint effect), not decided.
